title: CPU and GPU parallel image processing
highlights: Multithreaded CPU (Pthreads) and CUDA implementations for edge detection, bitmap flipping, rotation, Gaussian filtering, convolution and color transformations.
Optimized with workload partitioning, shared and constant memory, coalesced access, precomputation and tuned thread-block configurations, achieving 4-8x speedups over CPU.
Analyzed latency, occupancy, throughput, cache behavior and PCIe transfer overhead.
note: Source is in a private course repository for academic integrity. Access on request.
